meta.title: Harbour Flood Response
meta.subtitle: Two decisions while the harbour picture changes
meta.summary: In fictional Port Anand, choose a relief staging position and later a delivery route while delayed, grouped, noisy, and missing reports describe a quay and ridge road.
briefing: Port Anand is a fictional port city experiencing a synthetic flood. Relief supplies are waiting for a staging decision, followed by a separate delivery-route decision.
The north quay offers higher author-assigned payoffs if dry. The ridge road offers lower payoffs if open. Holding defers the corresponding activity with a small fixed payoff.
Choose a position between 12:00 and 26:00, then a route between 28:00 and 38:00. Waiting costs 1.2 points per minute for positioning and 1.0 per minute for routing after each window opens.

A drone sweep checks the north quay in five minutes for four points; a gauge check assesses the ridge road in four minutes for three points. Each asset can be used once per decision point on a dedicated tasking link.
Some routine reports share the same underlying observation. LAND messages may arrive in a burst; telemetry can be noisy, aerial reports delayed, and spectrum notices missing.

This is a synthetic training scenario. The reference model is a transparent scoring baseline, not real doctrine. All entities, reliabilities, utilities, and consequences are fictional authoring assumptions.

reports.claim: Harbour desk: north quay surface dry
reports.detail: An early synthetic observation describes a dry quay. The later aerial relay H02 repeats this same observation, not an independent source.

reports.claim: Aerial relay repeats the early dry-quay observation
reports.detail: This relay shares evidence group HQ1 with H01 and must not be counted as a second independent observation.
A synthetic ridge-road observation indicates the road is open. H04 carries telemetry derived from the same observation.

reports.claim: Telemetry relay repeats ridge-road open status
reports.detail: The report shares evidence group HR1 with H03; repeating the status does not provide independent corroboration.

reports.claim: Survey: water visible on the north quay
reports.detail: A new synthetic survey reports water on the quay, contradicting the earlier dry-surface group HQ1.

reports.claim: Harbour observation: quay surface covered by water
reports.detail: This independent synthetic observation is queued during the LAND burst window and arrives with other queued observations at 20:00.

reports.claim: Telemetry: quay surface indicator still reads dry
reports.detail: The noisy synthetic indicator conflicts with the new water observations. Its excess accuracy is halved by CYBER noise at issue.

reports.claim: Partial survey: visible quay section appears dry
reports.detail: A partial synthetic image suggests a dry section. The routine aerial link delays this report by four minutes; it contradicts HQ2 and HQ3.

reports.claim: Ridge desk: road remains open, observation incomplete
reports.detail: An independent, lower-reliability synthetic road observation is queued on LAND and delivered at the burst restoration.
The synthetic mesh contradicts the dry-surface reports. This observation was issued during the noise window and retains reduced accuracy after restoration.

reports.claim: Link monitor: spectrum notice unavailable on routine relay
reports.detail: An informational synthetic link notice issued during EW dropout. It is not evidence about quay or ridge truth and never reaches the routine feed.

reports.claim: Restored relay: unconfirmed quay water observation
reports.detail: A low-reliability synthetic relay after restoration adds an independent water observation. It is not a dedicated verification result.

decisionPoints.title: Choose a relief staging position
decisionPoints.prompt: Position supplies at the quay, on the ridge, or hold. Make a separate route decision in the next window.

actions.label: Position at the north quay
actions.description: Higher synthetic payoff if dry; a flooded quay disrupts staging.

consequences.headline: Supplies staged at the dry quay
consequences.narrative: In the synthetic outcome, the chosen quay position supports staging. Routing remains a separate decision.

consequences.headline: Flooding disrupts quay staging
consequences.narrative: In the synthetic outcome, water disrupts the chosen staging position. Routing remains a separate decision.

actions.label: Position on the ridge
actions.description: Moderate synthetic payoff if the road is open; closure disrupts staging.

consequences.headline: Supplies staged on the ridge
consequences.narrative: In the synthetic outcome, the open road permits ridge staging. Routing remains a separate decision.

consequences.headline: Road closure disrupts ridge staging
consequences.narrative: In the synthetic outcome, the road closure prevents the intended ridge staging.

actions.label: Hold the staging position
actions.description: Defer staging with a small fixed synthetic payoff.

consequences.headline: Staging deferred
consequences.narrative: The synthetic staging activity remains on hold. The next routing window still opens independently.

decisionPoints.title: Choose the relief delivery route
decisionPoints.prompt: Choose a quay route, a ridge route, or hold routing using the information now available.

actions.label: Route via the north quay
actions.description: Higher synthetic payoff if the quay is dry; flooding disrupts delivery.

consequences.headline: Synthetic delivery completes via the quay
consequences.narrative: The dry quay allows the fictional delivery activity to complete.

consequences.headline: Flooded quay interrupts synthetic delivery
consequences.narrative: Water at the fictional quay prevents completion of the chosen delivery activity.

actions.label: Route via the ridge road
actions.description: Moderate synthetic payoff if the road is open; closure prevents delivery.

consequences.headline: Synthetic delivery completes via the ridge
consequences.narrative: The open fictional ridge road allows delivery with the authored lower payoff.

consequences.headline: Closed ridge road interrupts synthetic delivery
consequences.narrative: The fictional road closure prevents the chosen delivery activity from completing.

actions.label: Hold the delivery route
actions.description: Defer delivery with a small fixed synthetic payoff.

consequences.headline: Synthetic delivery deferred
consequences.narrative: The fictional delivery remains on hold for a later exercise window.

injectPresets.label: Restore all synthetic links
injectPresets.description: Restore routine links without retiming reports already issued.
